as_told.title: 'Norton Air Force Base internal' PDF on Greer's DPI archive

plain: Steven Greer, a campaigner for UFO disclosure, says he has a full transcript of a man named Brad Sorensen talking to an aerospace writer, in which Sorensen says that ARVs, short for alien reproduction vehicles, craft built to copy alien ones, were being made by the late 1950s, with Norton Air Force Base in California tied to the story. Greer says he holds the transcript himself. A researcher known online as UAPGerb tells it differently: he says it was posted on an online archive called DPI as the "Norton Air Force Base internal" file, dates it to 1990, and names the writer as Bill Scott. If true, it would mean the US was building copies of alien craft within about a decade of the first famous sightings.
